categories.main_business_segments: Jilin Xidian Pharmaceutical Sci-Tech Development Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of chemical pharmaceutical raw materials and formulations. Its core business focuses on iron supplements, drugs for circulatory disorders, antipsychotic and antidepressant medications, and raw material pharmaceuticals. The company integrates raw material production with formulation manufacturing, emphasizing a vertically integrated 'raw material + formulation' model.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and pharmaceutical manufacturing techniques adhering to GMP standards. It utilizes a vertically integrated production method combining raw material synthesis and formulation manufacturing to ensure high-quality and consistent products. The company also invests in R&D collaborations, AI-driven drug discovery platforms, and continuous process optimization to enhance production efficiency and product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major pharmaceutical distributors and healthcare institutions across China, such as Sinopharm Holdings, China Resources Pharmaceutical Group, Guangzhou Pharmaceutical Group, Chongqing Pharmaceutical Group, and Jiuzhoutong Pharmaceutical Group. The company serves the domestic pharmaceutical market with a focus on prescription drugs for anemia, circulatory disorders, and mental health conditions, participating actively in national and provincial centralized drug procurement programs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales distributed across major regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. Its production facilities are located in Jilin Province, including the Panshi Economic Development Zone and the Jilin Chemical Industrial Circular Economy Park, with additional subsidiaries in Zhuhai and Jilin City.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jilin Xidian Pharmaceutical occupies an upstream and midstream position in the pharmaceutical supply chain by producing both active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished drug formulations. Its vertically integrated model allows control over raw material supply, manufacturing, and distribution, reducing dependency on external suppliers and enhancing supply chain resilience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in iron supplements, circulatory system drugs, and psychiatric medications, leveraging AI-driven drug discovery and collaborative R&D models. It focuses on expanding its product pipeline with new raw materials and formulations, improving quality standards, and accelerating regulatory approvals. Strategic initiatives include enhancing supply chain resilience, digital transformation, green manufacturing, and strengthening intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including chemical raw materials and finished drug formulations. The company employs direct sales and distribution channels, participates in government-led centralized procurement programs, and engages in academic promotion to drive product adoption. It also derives income from investment activities and government subsidies related to drug consistency evaluations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a competitive player in China's chemical pharmaceutical manufacturing sector, particularly in iron supplements and psychiatric drugs. It holds exclusive patents for key products like its compound ferrous sulfate folic acid tablets and unique raw materials such as Ruixiangsu. Competitors include other domestic pharmaceutical manufacturers specializing in similar therapeutic areas, but Xidian leverages its integrated supply chain and patented products to maintain a leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 256.4 million, a 13.7% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 40.3 million, a 20.3% decrease due to prior year government subsidies and raw material cost fluctuations. The company maintains stable profitability with a net asset base of around RMB 905.7 million and continues to invest heavily in R&D and production capacity expansion, including acquisitions and new subsidiaries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jilin Xidian Pharmaceutical emphasizes its patented, scientifically formulated compound ferrous sulfate folic acid tablets with superior absorption and safety profiles, especially for vulnerable populations like pregnant women. Its unique oral disintegrating risperidone tablets offer rapid onset and improved patient compliance. The vertically integrated 'raw material + formulation' model ensures product quality consistency and cost advantages. The company also focuses on academic promotion and real-world evidence to build brand trust and differentiate from generic competitors.
